key_facts: Project: Document generator for Russian hackathon
Pipeline: user text → AI → validation → Typst template → PDF → Pandoc → DOCX
Templates generate Typst wrapper, not body content
AI prompt asks for JSON with correctedText and requisites
Document types: sluzhebnaya, dokladnaya, informacionnaya, pismo
Each document type has sections and required fields
Current templates treat all types as single body block
AI output reported as poor quality - body text missing or wrong
call_chains: AI fix loop: compile error → patchTypstErrors → retry compile
research_sources: Hackathon requirements: not less than 2 templates, visual differences, document type determines structure

data.for_teamlead: GREEN. The architecture is sound but the AI prompt needs improvement. The templates are correct for visual formatting, but the AI must generate structured content per document type. Recommend updating the AI prompt to include document type structure with examples. Keep templates as-is for hackathon simplicity. Test with sample inputs for each document type.
data.for_successor: Tech Lead should update the AI prompt in packages/backend/src/prompts/document-prompts.ts to include document type structure. Provide examples for each document type showing expected sections (greeting, body, closing). Then test with sample inputs. If time allows, extend DocumentData to include sections and update templates.
